title: EncoTESS: Age-Sensitive Encodings from Raw TESS Light Curves
abstract: arXiv:2608.25019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Main sequence stars of spectral types late F through M exhibit systematic variability in photometric light curves, particularly when they are young. Rotational modulation of starspots manifests as quasi-sinusoidal variability, which enables the measurement of rotation periods. Variability can also be stochastic, as in stellar flaring. However, since measurements of stochastic processes depend on the time of observation, they are typically noisier. Considering that different manifestations of variability have unique observational nuances, models that naturally unify these are incredibly useful for stellar characterization. Towards this goal, we have developed EncoTESS: a Time Series Foundation Model (TSFM) trained on a subset of TESS 2-min light curves. EncoTESS is specifically designed to handle the observational noise, heteroskedastic measurements, irregular sampling, and large data gaps common to TESS data. It is also ~1% of the size

translated_title: EncoTESS：来自原始TESS光变曲线的年龄敏感编码
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.25019v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：光谱类型为晚F到M的主序星在光度光变曲线中表现出系统性变化，尤其是当它们年轻的时候。星斑的旋转调制表现为准正弦变化，这使我们能够测量旋转周期。变化也可能是随机的，例如恒星耀发。然而，由于随机过程的测量依赖于观测时间，它们通常噪声更大。考虑到不同形式的变化具有独特的观测特征，能够自然统一这些特征的模型对于恒星表征极为有用。为此，我们开发了EncoTESS：一种基于TESS 2分钟光变曲线子集训练的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）。EncoTESS专门设计用于处理TESS数据中常见的观测噪声、异方差测量、不规则采样和大数据间隙。它的规模也仅为常规模型的约1%。
tldr: 本文提出EncoTESS，一种紧凑的时间序列基础模型，通过处理TESS光变曲线的噪声、异方差和间隙，有效编码恒星年龄敏感特征，并以极小的模型规模实现恒星表征。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EncoTESS, a compact time-series foundation model that encodes age-sensitive features from TESS light curves by handling noise, heteroskedasticity, and gaps, achieving stellar characterization at only ~1% of typical model size.
